title: Immutable learned generations and barriers
summary: Published learned generations freeze a model point for later comparison; explicit barriers mark source/domain discontinuities where learned continuity must be reconsidered.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: A published generation never follows later live mutations.
A source barrier is evidence about discontinuity, not an automatic guess about which state to reset.
Generation identity records branch and journal point.
procedure: Publish MLLearnedGeneration after a meaningful learning milestone.
Attach MLSourceIdentity when source-code revision evidence is available.
Create MLLearningBarrier at camera/source, calibration, schema or domain changes.
